subject.title: Clarify status of optional bird transport

question: Should Birdclaw continue documenting `bird` as a recommended optional transport for new users, and what public install/source path should replace the deprecated npm package and unavailable GitHub links?
rationale: The source still supports `bird` and docs intentionally describe it, but the external package/repository support policy is outside what source inspection can safely decide.

options.title: Document xurl public default
options.body: Keep `bird` support in code, make `xurl` the public default in docs, and add the current `bird` access path or an explicit private/advanced-user note.

options.title: Restore public bird distribution
options.body: Undeprecate or republish the `bird` package/repository, then update Birdclaw docs to point at the working public install path.

options.title: Demote bird for new users
options.body: Leave existing `bird` code paths for current users but remove the public install recommendation until the external distribution is supportable.

recommendation.title: Document xurl public default
recommendation.body: Keep `bird` support in code, make `xurl` the public default in docs, and add the current `bird` access path or an explicit private/advanced-user note.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision hinges on steipete-owned `bird` package/repository policy and the current Birdclaw live-transport recommendation.
